first.rationale: I currently intend to test onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests onboarding changes can improve time-to-value and early adoption. I would verify the onboarding result and compare it with the strongest alternatives: promotional pricing for price-sensitive SMBs and activation messaging. A guarded test protects qualified-revenue quality while addressing funnel deterioration without assuming that competitor pricing is the primary cause.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and previously improved time-to-value, early adoption, and 30-day retention by 3%, making it the strongest sustainable qualified-revenue option. Activation messaging is a credible secondary lever, but onboarding has stronger downstream retention evidence and addresses both current symptoms. Avoid promotional pricing despite acquisition lift because the verified cohort suffered a 12% 30-day retention decline and failed to sustain value through renewal.
